name: Koukai ~Makan no Kokuin~
source:
One day, the main character, an ex-priest, visits a mission school. The purpose of his visit is to take revenge on Karen. He was dismissed from his church before due to Karen's accusation. To wreak vengeance on her, he secretly begins to take action....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081029043303/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1007796]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
一天，曾经担任神父的主人公来到一所教会学校。他此行的目的是向卡莲复仇。此前，正是卡莲的指控导致他被教会革职。为了报复她，他开始暗中行动……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081029043303/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1007796]ErogeShop[/url]]
